toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hoor die antwoord' reads woodenly; 'luister na hulle antwoord' is the natural Afrikaans and echoes the listening the block teaches.
toegepas.fout: 'hoor die antwoord' is flat; it says the answer reaches the leader, not that she attends to it, in a block about listening.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'luister na hulle antwoord' is the natural Afrikaans for paying attention to an answer, keeps the same people and order, and 'daardie antwoord' in the next sentence still points to it.

toegepas.voor: te groot vir een paar hande om alleen te doen
toegepas.na: te groot vir een persoon om alleen te doen
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'One pair of hands' is an English image that sounds translated in Afrikaans; 'een persoon' says the same plainly.
toegepas.fout: 'een paar hande' copies the English image 'one pair of hands' and reads translated.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'een persoon' says exactly the same thing plainly and is easier for a Grade 4 reader.

toegepas.blok: Dit is nie altyd maklik nie
toegepas.voor: 'n groep lei met baie werk en min tyd
toegepas.na: 'n groep lei wat baie werk en min tyd het
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written, 'met baie werk en min tyd' can attach to 'lei' (leading with much work); the relative clause makes clear it is the group that has the work and little time.
toegepas.fout: 'met baie werk en min tyd' dangles after 'lei' and can be read as describing the leading rather than the group.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The relative clause makes plain that the group has much work and little time, which is what the scenario means, and removes the stumble without adding anything.

laat_vaar.voor: 'n taak wat hy goed kan doen
laat_vaar.na: 'n taak wat hy of sy goed kan doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The leader is 'sy' throughout, so a bare 'hy' for 'elkeen' right after 'Sy' jars; the lesson already uses 'sy of haar' elsewhere.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Generic 'hy' after 'elkeen' is standard Afrikaans and cannot point to the leader, who is 'Sy'; adding 'of sy' puts a second 'sy' in the sentence that could be read as the leader.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Die beste een' copies English 'the best one'; 'die beste daarvan' is the standard Afrikaans construction.
na_skrywer.fout: 'die beste een' copies English 'the best one'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but 'die beste daarvan' loses the singular (one idea chosen) and can read as using the best parts of several ideas, so the writer should fix it another way.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In the list this item alone starts with a capital letter while the other seven start lower case; the capital looks like an inconsistency rather than a choice, and a person may want to align it (the words themselves stay).
